name: Josiah deGrasse
title: Human Factors + AI Product Designer
summary: I turn complex AI and technical workflows into clear, useful experiences. My work combines Human Factors research, interaction design, and rapid prototyping with AI development tools.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Human Factors Engineering

experience.context: Functional focus; position originally titled AI Product Engineer.
bullets: Hired by the project sponsor to develop a Tufts capstone into a working sensory-intelligence platform for food-development teams.
Designed a connected journey across instrument evidence, sensory studies, insights, product decisions, concept testing, and reports.
Translated complex methodology into an explainable GO / TWEAK / STOP decision framework with evidence context and explicit human review.
Shaped role-specific workflows and reviewable AI assistance; used AI development tools to prototype and iterate on the working product.
Conducted 8 user interviews and stakeholder sessions to understand enterprise AI workflows and identify 3 validated design opportunities.
Designed and tested two concepts: a source-grounded AI assistant and a rule-based workflow, using Figma prototypes.
Refined the experience around visibility, source grounding, rollback, and human control; validated the design direction with Red Hat product leadership.
Designed production fixtures for robotic welders and CNC machinery, improving boiler-head throughput from 3 heads per 3-hour run to 8 per 45 minutes.
Created 1,000+ SolidWorks components and digital twins to support fabrication, documentation, and shop-floor decisions.

skills.label: Design & research
skills.text: Human Factors, UX research, task analysis, stakeholder interviews, journey mapping, information architecture, interaction design, prototyping, usability testing, Figma.

skills.label: AI & making
skills.text: Human-in-the-loop design, evidence-based decision support, AI-assisted prototyping, data visualization, SolidWorks, CAD, 3D printing.
